senses.sense_definition: Having a roof supported by rows of columns or pillars.

examples.text: The ancient temple featured a vast <w>hypostyle</w> hall designed to impress visiting dignitaries.
Archaeologists uncovered the remains of a monumental <w>hypostyle</w> chamber dating to the Persian period.

senses.sense_definition: A large hall or building with a flat roof supported by rows of columns.

examples.text: Visitors walked through the grand <w>hypostyle</w>, marveling at the towering stone pillars.
The palace included an impressive <w>hypostyle</w> that served as the central reception area.
